papers.title_en: Flow Matching for Fluctuation-Based Fluorescence Super-Resolution
papers.authors: Alberto Cozzani, Giacomo Meanti, Laure Blanc-Féraud, Luca Calatroni
papers.evidence: 流匹配生成式荧光超分辨率重建
papers.tldr: 基于涨落的荧光超分辨虽适配常规采集，但多数方法缺乏显式成像模型且只给相对强度，限制定量分析。该工作用flow matching学习数据分布，并结合双泊松前向模型描述闪烁、模糊、欠采样与噪声，交替优化样本和背景。在仿真与Argolight真实数据上可分辨120 nm线，优于SACD和eSRRF。它把生成式先验与模型驱动估计结合，提升了涨落超分辨的定量重建能力。
papers.abstract_en: Fluctuation-based super-resolution techniques are an appealing alternative to single-molecule and structured-illumination microscopy, as they adapt to standard acquisition settings and exploit the independent stochastic fluctuations of fluorophores across a sequence of frames. However, most existing approaches lack an explicit model of the acquisition process and provide only relative intensity estimates, limiting quantitative analyses. In this work, we combine model-based and generative approaches to exploit the full stochastic information in the sequence, proposing a reconstruction framework built on flow matching and a double-Poisson forward model accounting for blinking, blur, under-sampling and noise. The method alternates two steps: a flow matching model first learns the distribution of the acquired data; then, the sample and the background are jointly estimated by minimising a Kullback-Leibler divergence between observed and simulated distributions via regularised proximal gradient steps. On simulated and real Argolight data, the method resolves lines separated by 120 nm, outperforming SACD and eSRRF.

papers.title_en: UniTele: Learning Device-Conditioned Degradations for Unified Smartphone Telephoto Super-Resolution
papers.authors: Yuchen Zhang, Aojie Li, Wei Cheng, Xianfang Zeng, Runxing Liu, haixin hao, Gang YU, Xiaoyun Yuan
papers.evidence: 学习设备条件退化的手机长焦超分辨率
papers.tldr: 手机超长焦成像存在强设备相关的复杂退化，传统手工流程难以刻画，而跨机型采集大规模对齐样本成本高。UniTele 将退化学习拆为设备成像特性与超长焦额外信息损失/伪影两个可学习组件，并基于华为、苹果、vivo 的三机型基准学习退化，再迁移到外部图像合成数千训练对。以 Qwen 与 FLUX 为骨干训练统一超分模型后，留出集上的配对复原保真度和感知相似度显著提升，复原更稳定、视觉更忠实。
papers.abstract_en: Super-telephoto imaging on mobile phones suffers from complex, device-dependent degradations that are poorly captured by conventional handcrafted pipelines. Collecting large-scale aligned training pairs across different phones and diverse scenes, however, is both costly and difficult to scale. We therefore study whether device-specific degradations can be learned from only a small number of physical captures and transferred for training a unified super-resolution (SR) model. Our key idea is to factor degradation learning into two learnable components: one captures the device-specific imaging characteristics under well-resolved conditions, while the other captures the additional information loss and artifacts that arise in super-telephoto imaging. We build a paired benchmark across three phone brands (Huawei, Apple, and vivo) by photographing the same content at two display sizes and zoom settings. The larger displayed image is captured at the phone's maximum optical zoom setting, while the smaller image is photographed directly at the phone's highest native zoom setting through the phone's native imaging pipeline. The benchmark contains 519 training and 60 held-out pairs. We use the benchmark to learn device-specific degradation, then apply it to external images to synthesize thousands of additional pairs to train our UniTele SR model. Relative to the pretrained Qwen and FLUX backbones before adaptation, the full UniTele training recipe substantially improves paired restoration fidelity and perceptual similarity on the held-out benchmark and yields markedly more stable and visually faithful restorations.

papers.title_en: Concept Acupuncturist: An Efficient and Precise Concept Erasure Method for Diffusion Models via Sparse Autoencoders
papers.authors: Yiran Xiahou, Siliang Qin, Kai Chen, Shengzhi Zhang, Renyang Liu
papers.evidence: 基于稀疏自编码器的扩散模型概念擦除
papers.tldr: 扩散模型可能生成有害内容，机器遗忘需在移除目标概念的同时保留通用能力，但概念表征分布且纠缠，现有全轨迹微调效率低、编辑不精确。ConceptACP将语义概念映射到U-Net交叉注意力块，定位最相关块做免推理微调，并借助稀疏自编码器构造特征级校正信号。在SDXL-Turbo单步生成下，遗忘成功率平均较最佳基线提升36.34个百分点，同时保持图像质量与提示保真度。该工作实现了高效、细粒度且可迁移的概念擦除。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based image generation models produce high-quality images but may generate harmful or policy-violating content, motivating machine unlearning (MU) to selectively remove target concepts while preserving general capabilities. However, existing MU approaches often struggle with the distributed and entangled nature of concept representations, leading to inefficient optimization and imprecise edits when applied through large-scale fine-tuning over full diffusion trajectories. To bridge this gap, we propose Concept Acupuncturist (ConceptACP), a novel MU framework that integrates interpretability-guided analysis with inference-free fine-tuning for efficient and precise concept removal. By establishing mappings between semantic concepts and cross-attention blocks in the U-Net denoiser and localizing the most concept-relevant block for targeted optimization, ConceptACP avoids full diffusion trajectory optimization, thereby improving fine-tuning efficiency. To mitigate concept entanglement, we propose a feature-level correction mechanism based on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), where SAE-derived sparse, semantically meaningful feature activations are manipulated to construct targeted correction signals, which are then projected back to the output space of the corresponding block and used as supervision for precise concept removal. Consequently, ConceptACP eliminates the need for external inference-time modules while achieving efficient and fine-grained unlearning. Instantiated on SDXL-Turbo, ConceptACP improves the forgetting success rate by 36.34 percentage points in the standard one-step generation setting on average over the best-performing baseline, while preserving image quality and prompt fidelity, and generalizes effectively across other Stable Diffusion backbones. Our code is available at https://github.com/Eran-Xia/ConceptACP.

papers.evidence: 利用扩散模型从局部分布外干扰中恢复干净图像
papers.tldr: 真实信号常被未知分布的局部结构化扰动污染，如背景噪声、水印和阴影。SORD 仅利用腐坏支撑二值图与一个在干净信号上预训练的扩散模型，迭代恢复干净信号，无需配对数据或扰动统计模型。在图像、人脸和音频任务上，它优于同先验同掩码的后验采样修复和需分源模型的分离基线，部分基准超过监督网络。该工作为未知局部 OOD 腐坏去除提供了通用且少假设的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world signals are corrupted by localized, structured perturbations whose distribution is unknown: an intermittent background noise in a music recording, a watermark stamped on a photograph, a cast shadow. We study the task of recovering a clean signal $x$ from an observation $y$ containing such a localized out-of-distribution (OOD) corruption. We propose Support-guided OOD Removal with Diffusion, SORD, an iterative algorithm to recover $x$ using only two ingredients: a binary map of the corruption support and a single diffusion model pretrained on clean signals. SORD does not require any paired data or any statistical model of the corruption. We evaluate SORD on natural images and human faces with spatially localized corruptions including handwritten digits, other images, watermarks, and shadows, as well as audio recordings of different musical instruments with temporally localized corruptions including other instruments and human speech. SORD is competitive with, and often outperforms, posterior-sampling inpainting given the same diffusion prior and the same mask, source-separation baselines that require a separate diffusion model for each source, and, on several benchmarks, supervised networks trained on paired clean and corrupted signals. The code is released here: \href{https://github.com/voilalab/SORD}{https://github.com/voilalab/SORD}.

papers.title_en: Rethinking Microscopy Generation: Co-Designed Diffusion for Biologically Interpretable Single-Cell Synthesis
papers.authors: Shumpei Takezaki, Duway Nicolas Lesmes-Leon, Ryoma Bise, Gillian Lovell, Bianca Migliori, Andreas Dengel, Sheraz Ahmed
papers.evidence: 可控单细胞合成的扩散显微图像生成
papers.tldr: 显微图像生成模型已能合成逼真的整幅视野，却无法对单个细胞的外观进行可控且可解释的调控。作者把生成任务下沉到单细胞层面，将输入条件与模型潜空间同时对齐到一组语义轴（尺寸、伸长、亮度、纹理等），并提出潜空间与这些测量显式对齐的 BioVAE。在 LIVECell 上，语义轴条件显著优于高维条件，生物学家盲评确认生成细胞真实，逐轴遍历产生稳定可解释的表型变化。该工作表明条件与潜表示必须协同设计，才能实现生物学可解释的单细胞合成。
papers.abstract_en: Generative models for microscopy can already produce realistic whole-image fields of view, but offer no principled way to control how each individual cell looks. We address this gap by recasting microscopy generation at the single-cell level and designing the input controls and the model's internal representation jointly, so that both are organized along the same biologically meaningful directions. On the input side, we aggregate a long list of standard cell measurements into a small set of semantic axes (size, elongation, brightness, texture, etc.) that are each named, measurable, and traversable. On the model side, we introduce BioVAE, an encoder-decoder whose latent space is explicitly aligned with the same set of measurements. A key finding is that the benefit of biologically structuring the latent emerges only when conditioning is also moved to the semantic axes, showing that the two ends must be designed jointly. Experiments on LIVECell show that semantic-axis conditioning substantially improves generative fidelity over high-dimensional conditioning, a blind study with biologists confirms the realism of generated cells, and per-axis traversals produce stable and interpretable phenotypic changes.

papers.title_en: Know, then Draw: A New Learning Paradigm for Visual Generation
papers.authors: Yucheng Mao, Chongjian Ge, Zhuowen Tu, Hao Tan, Hanwen Jiang
papers.evidence: 结合自回归预训练与扩散渲染的新生成范式
papers.tldr: 视觉生成需同时具备高层语义知识与细粒度像素细节。提出先自回归预训练学习知识、再扩散后训练高保真渲染的新学习范式，并系统研究目标、表示与缩放。受控对比发现自回归是更强的预训练目标，可提升学习效率与最终生成质量，且语义质量比纯 AR 生成质量更关键。据此设计仅用语言监督、无需图像解码器与重建损失的纯语义 tokenizer，并建立计算最优缩放律。3B 文生图模型仅用 6600 H100 GPU 小时，在 GenEval 得 86、DPG-Bench 得 87。
papers.abstract_en: Visual generation requires both high-level semantic knowledge and fine-grained pixel details. We propose a learning paradigm that assigns these roles to autoregressive pretraining for knowledge acquisition and diffusion post-training for high-fidelity rendering. Within this framework, we study the objective, representation, and scaling of knowledge acquisition and rendering. Controlled comparisons identify autoregression as the stronger pretraining objective for downstream rendering, improving both learning efficiency and final generation quality. We further find that AR-only generation quality does not necessarily correlate with final performance; semantic quality matters more. This motivates a purely semantic tokenizer trained with language supervision alone, without an image decoder or reconstruction loss. We establish compute-optimal scaling laws for knowledge acquisition and rendering, and find that autoregressive pretraining lowers the fitted asymptotic rendering loss compared with pixel diffusion models trained from scratch. Guided by the laws, we train a 3B-parameter text-to-image model with only 6,600 H100 GPU-hours, achieving 86 on GenEval and 87 on DPG-Bench and validating the proposed paradigm at scale.

papers.title_en: Cascaded Posterior Sampling With Diffusion Priors for highly Accelerated MRI
papers.authors: Jyothi Rikhab Chand, Sahil Murtaza, Patrick Nicholas Nowak, Mathews Jacob
papers.evidence: 用于加速MRI重建的级联扩散先验后验采样
papers.tldr: 高加速MRI需要强先验，但高分辨率扩散模型网络大、计算贵。论文提出级联后验采样框架，以低分辨率无条件扩散模型恢复粗图，再用小规模条件扩散模型刻画细尺度细节，并与全部测量做线性数据一致性。多线圈脑MRI在15倍加速下较最佳单尺度扩散基线PSNR提升4–6 dB，且各子网络约小10倍；问题越病态增益越明显。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are powerful priors for inverse problems, including accelerated MRI. However, modeling the distribution of high-resolution images requires large networks with high computational cost. We propose a posterior sampling framework that uses cascaded diffusion models as multiscale priors. Conditioned on a coarse image, the distribution of fine-scale detail is local and well conditioned, and it can therefore be captured by a small network. Similarly, a small unconditional network is sufficient to represent low-resolution images, and it is used to recover the coarse image from the k-space center. This estimate then conditions the high-resolution prior, which is combined with all measurements to recover the final image. Both priors are trained on images alone, so they apply to any sampling pattern, and data consistency remains linear at every scale. In multi-coil brain MRI, the proposed method improves on the best single-scale diffusion baseline by 4-6 dB in PSNR at 15x acceleration, while each of its separately trained networks is about 10x smaller. The gain grows as the problem becomes more ill-posed, and ablations show that it arises from informative low-resolution conditioning.

papers.title_en: A First-Step Bias Restores Lost Diversity in Diffusion Model Distillation
papers.authors: Wenwu Tang, Dong Wang, Yun Cheng, Olga Saukh
papers.evidence: 扩散模型蒸馏与样本多样性
papers.tldr: 扩散模型蒸馏可用少步采样生成高质量图像，但学生模型常把不同初始噪声映射为相似输出，导致多样性丢失。作者沿采样轨迹比较师生模型，发现首个高噪声去噪步的噪声响应缩减最大，并提出仅在该步加入种子响应偏置适配器的ReSeed，使其速度对齐教师首区间割线速度。在SD3、FLUX.1-dev和Wan2.1等模型上，ReSeed仅增加0.00196%可训练参数，将4步FLUX.1-dev的DINO多样性提升48.3%，同时保持有竞争力的画质。
papers.abstract_en: Distribution-matching distillation enables high-quality image generation in only a few denoising steps. However, distilled student models often map different initial noise samples to similar outputs under the same prompt. To locate where diversity is lost, we compare the teacher and student along the sampling trajectory. The largest measured reduction in the response to different initial noises occurs during the first, high-noise step. When we replace the first step with the teacher's corresponding trajectory and leave the final three student steps unchanged, most of the output diversity returns. This suggests that the first step is a key point for restoring diversity. Motivated by this finding, we introduce \emph{ReSeed}, a post-distillation method that adds a seed-response bias adapter only to the first student step and aligns its velocity with the teacher's first-interval secant velocity. All student weights and later denoising steps remain unchanged. We evaluate ReSeed on three text-to-image models (SD3-Medium, SD3.5-Medium, and FLUX.1-dev) and one text-to-video model (Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B). For a distilled 4-step FLUX.1-dev model, \emph{ReSeed} requires only $0.00196\%$ additional trainable parameters relative to the base model and is trained on 8,000 prompt--noise pairs, while keeping the distilled student fully frozen and requiring no target images, perceptual losses, or adversarial losses. It improves DINO diversity by $48.3\%$ while maintaining competitive visual quality. These results show that substantial diversity can be recovered through a lightweight, data-efficient tuning of only the first denoising step, without finetuning the full student model.

papers.title_en: The Noise Plane: A Diffusion Bridge Across Exponent and Dispersion
papers.authors: Xuran Hu, Yuru Jia, Tengxi Wang, Miloš Daković, Ljubiša Stanković, Wufan Zhao
papers.evidence: 面向 Tweedie 噪声与复原的测量索引扩散框架
papers.tldr: 扩散去噪通常假设高斯噪声，但传感器噪声常随信号强度变化，服从Tweedie分布族。论文提出p-Bridge，以噪声指数p和累积测量ν构成“噪声平面”，用独立增量扩散桥统一高斯、泊松与Gamma去噪，并将去噪解释为测量累积。方法共享反向均值更新与deviance目标，单一p条件网络适配不同噪声模型。实验显示跨指数鲁棒性提升，估计指数下接近五个专家模型的oracle选择。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based denoising commonly uses Gaussian perturbations, whereas sensor noise follows diverse signal-dependent statistical laws. In this paper, we propose $p$-Bridge, a unified measurement-indexed diffusion framework for Tweedie noise. The noise exponent $p$ describes the variance--intensity relation, while accumulated measurement $ν$ controls the noise level. Together, they define a noise plane that includes Gaussian, Poisson, and Gamma models. The stochastic bridge connects measurement distributions through independent increments, giving denoising a physical interpretation as progressive measurement accumulation. Both the starting and stopping indices can be specified, allowing restoration from an observed measurement level to a prescribed higher level. Measurement superposition yields a shared reverse-mean update, paired with a deviance-based objective for learning the required conditional mean. A latent compound Poisson--Gamma construction enables sampling at intermediate exponents. A single exponent-conditioned network adapts to different Tweedie noise models without separate training for each exponent. Experiments show that exponent conditioning improves cross-exponent robustness over fixed-exponent models. Using estimated exponents, the shared network achieves robustness comparable to an oracle-selected set of five specialist models. Experiments on synthetic images, FMD fluorescence microscopy, and multi-sensor SAR images further demonstrate its effectiveness across different signal-dependent noise regimes.

papers.title_en: Guidance-Coupled Nullspace Drifting for One-Step Medical Image Reconstruction
papers.authors: M. Tuna Alatan, Agah Server Tapan, Şaban Öztürk, Muhammad Usama Mirza, Bilal Kabas, Ge Wang, Tolga Çukur
papers.evidence: 结合成像算子的漂移建模实现一步生成式图像重建
papers.tldr: 医学图像生成式重建常依赖迭代采样，推理成本高且难以兼顾真实感与保真度；现有漂移模型虽可单步采样，却未纳入成像算子。DriftRecon将漂移建模限制在成像算子的零空间，用零空间噪声构造训练样本，并以多尺度生成器在各分辨率引入测量条件、将生成分量投影至零空间。推理时用条件引导参数连续调节测量条件生成与无条件生成，并设计随引导变化的相似核温度调度以稳定漂移交互。稀疏视图CT与加速MRI实验表明，该方法单次前向即可重建，性能优于既有生成式重建和近期漂移模型。
papers.abstract_en: Generative reconstruction can recover high-quality images from undersampled acquisitions, but state-of-the-art generative priors commonly rely on iterative sampling. Reducing the number of iterations lowers inference cost but also removes opportunities for progressive distributional refinement, making it difficult to retain image realism without sacrificing reconstruction fidelity. Drift modeling offers an alternative by shifting progressive refinement to training, thereby enabling one-step sampling without an iterative inference trajectory. Existing drifting methods, however, do not account for the imaging operator when modeling distributional drift. We propose DriftRecon, a generative method for one-step medical image reconstruction that performs drifting directly in the nullspace of the imaging operator. DriftRecon uses nullspace-restricted noise to construct training samples and a multiscale generator that incorporates measurement conditioning across resolution levels, with its generated component projected onto the operator nullspace. To control the fidelity--realism trade-off at inference, a conditional guidance parameter continuously steers the same generator between measurement-conditioned and unconditional generation. We derive a guidance-dependent similarity-kernel temperature schedule that preserves the guidance-weighted mass receiving strengthened supervision, thereby progressively localizing drift interactions as guidance increases to limit the associated loss of reconstruction fidelity. Experiments in sparse-view CT and accelerated MRI reconstruction show that DriftRecon outperforms established generative reconstruction methods and recent drifting models while producing reconstructions in a single forward pass.

papers.title_en: ImageRSI: Verification-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Image Generation
papers.authors: Shuo Han, Zhilin Wang, Peng Ling, Wenjia Gong, Yang Liu, Guanjun Jiang, Yukun Cao, Xike Xie
papers.evidence: 基于验证与修复的智能体文生图生成
papers.tldr: 复杂文生图请求难以稳定满足，单次验证修复虽能改善单张图，却难以迁移到其他请求。ImageRSI保持生成器冻结，结合任务内五维验证修复、跨任务经验库与离线更新评判器，并用配对A/B验证筛选经验。在MindBench上CSA达52.6%，在新建ImageReq-Bench上达65.66%。该框架把单次修复转化为可复用、可验证的自我改进能力。
papers.abstract_en: Complex text-to-image requests remain difficult to satisfy reliably. Verifying and repairing an image can fix an individual output, but a successful repair does not necessarily carry over to other requests. We present ImageRSI, a framework that keeps the image generator frozen and combines three components: five-dimensional verification and repair within each task, an experience library shared across tasks, and offline updating of the judge. Candidate experiences enter the library only after paired A/B validation, and the judge is updated with supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on accumulated image-judgment records and evaluated before reuse. We also introduce ImageReq-Bench, a benchmark of 961 requests built around hard cases in real-world image-generation requests, each paired with an evaluation checklist. ImageRSI achieves a Checklist Strict Accuracy (CSA) of 52.6% on MindBench (with Nano Banana Pro as the generator) and 65.66% on ImageReq-Bench, and we compare system outcomes across judge-training configurations.

papers.authors: Ren Ajiki, Ryugo Morita, Stanislav Frolov, Brian Bernhard Moser, Ko Watanabe, Riku Takahashi, Andreas Dengel, Jinjia Zhou
papers.evidence: 面向布局感知生成的免训练退火扩散采样
papers.tldr: 布局感知文生图需要严格保留标题、Logo或UI等干净区域，现有方法常引入多余内容或破坏视觉一致性。PASTA提出免训练退火扩散采样，在共享潜变量轨迹上按掩码融合全提示与上下文提示引导。它早期抑制语义泄漏、后期恢复一致性，从而提升保留区保真度并维持整体真实感。该工作为保留区域约束提供更实用的采样方案。
papers.abstract_en: While Diffusion models produce high-quality images, real-world visual design requires intentionally preserving clean regions for headlines, logos, or UI elements. Existing layout-aware text-to-image methods struggle to strictly preserve reserved regions, often introducing unwanted content that complicates downstream editing. Existing approaches either manipulate attention to displace content or suppress conditioning via noise-level interventions. However, these methods sacrifice visual coherence, producing flat regions or noticeable style inconsistencies between reserved and non-reserved areas. To address this limitation, we propose a Prompt-Aware Shared-Latent Training-Free Annealed Diffusion Sampling (PASTA), a training-free framework that enforces reserved-region constraints by selectively applying semantic guidance to object-allowed regions during sampling. PASTA operates on a shared latent trajectory, where full-prompt and context-prompt guidance are fused through mask-guided sampling. An annealed schedule suppresses semantic leakage during early denoising stages while gradually restoring visual consistency in later stages. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PASTA improves reserved-region fidelity while preserving overall image realism and perceptual consistency.

papers.title_en: AlphaAnything: Extending Pretrained RGB Generators to RGBA
papers.authors: Qijie Wang, Zhixin Xu, Zhe Li, Haowei Zhu, Honghao Qiao, Bo Peng, Dawei Li, Bin Wang
papers.evidence: 将预训练RGB生成器扩展到RGBA
papers.tldr: 现有RGBA生成方法通常需通过重建学习透明度专用表示，引入额外训练阶段，且可能改变预训练模型原有的RGB解码函数。AlphaAnything提出轻量框架，直接在预训练RGB生成器的原始潜空间中扩展出RGBA能力，无需RGBA重建预训练。方法在生成Transformer中插入LoRA模块，并在冻结的RGB VAE解码器上附加alpha分支，通过单向RGB到alpha特征共享让不透明度监督塑造生成潜变量，同时保证固定潜变量下RGB解码与预训练完全一致。还提出端点感知Alpha损失EA Loss，从合成所用的前景-背景互补权重导出不透明度监督。文生RGBA与图生RGBA实验在多个RGB骨干上取得有竞争力质量。
papers.abstract_en: Existing RGBA generation methods commonly learn a transparency-specific representation through reconstruction, introducing an additional training stage and potentially altering the RGB decoding function inherited from pretrained models. We present AlphaAnything, a lightweight framework that extends pretrained RGB generators to RGBA directly in their original latent space, without RGBA reconstruction pretraining. AlphaAnything inserts LoRA modules into the generative transformer and attaches an alpha branch to the frozen RGB VAE decoder. Unidirectional RGB-to-alpha feature sharing allows opacity supervision to shape the generative latent while guaranteeing that, for any fixed latent, RGB decoding remains identical to that of the pretrained decoder. We further introduce Endpoint-Aware Alpha Loss (EA Loss), which derives opacity supervision from the complementary foreground--background weights used in compositing. It supports exact opacity endpoints and continuous partial transparency while emphasizing localized alpha errors. Experiments on text-to-RGBA and image-to-RGBA tasks across multiple pretrained RGB backbones demonstrate competitive generation quality, and controlled ablations validate the shared-latent training design and EA Loss.

papers.title_en: Fast and Useful: Adapting Distilled Generators for Visual Learning
papers.authors: Patryk Bartkowiak, Dominik Michels, Sören Pirk, Wojciech Pałubicki
papers.evidence: 适配蒸馏文本到图像扩散生成器
papers.tldr: 蒸馏文生图模型生成快，但其图像训练的分类器明显弱于慢速基模型。作者对学生首次预测拟合低秩更新，使其到达无引导基模型的中间状态，随后禁用更新并让原学生完成生成；基模型只提供监督目标，推理时不需存在。在ImageNet-1k全量类别名模板下，ResNet-50 top-1从8.4%升至34.2%（FLUX.2-klein）、12.7%升至32.1%（SD-Turbo）。该单步适配让快速生成器更适合训练视觉模型。
papers.abstract_en: Distilled text-to-image models generate images quickly, but classifiers trained on those images can perform substantially worse than classifiers trained on images from their slower base models. We adapt released distilled generators to produce better training data while retaining fast generation. We fit a low-rank update to the student's first prediction so that it reaches an intermediate state produced by its unguided base, then disable the update and let the unchanged student finish generation. The base supplies training targets and is absent at inference. Guided targets and shorter jumps give classifiers lower accuracy in our ablations, showing why the state used for supervision matters. Across three generator families, the adapted images train better classifiers than images from the released students. With class-name templates at full ImageNet-1k scale, ResNet-50 top-1 rises from 8.4% to 34.2% for FLUX.2-klein and from 12.7% to 32.1% for SD-Turbo, using two and three denoiser evaluations per image, respectively. Fixed adapters also improve results on additional classes, fine-grained datasets, and other learner architectures and training recipes. Template-based adaptation remains useful against richer-prompt alternatives, while the benefit of combining adaptation with LLM generation prompts depends on the generator. Adapting a single generation step makes fast generators substantially more useful for training visual models.

papers.title_en: ResGVC: Residual Coding for High-fidelity Generative Video Compression
papers.authors: Ding Ding, Daowen Li, Ying Chen, Kai Li
papers.evidence: 在生成式视频压缩中通过传输残差引导解码端扩散去噪
papers.tldr: 生成式视频压缩多依赖解码端扩散先验去噪，且常在潜空间操作，易受表示瓶颈影响。ResGVC将编解码重建与原图失真分解为逐步残差段，并用扩散Transformer熵模型压缩残差，在像素空间去噪中引入显式源约束。相比此前最优方法，其在LPIPS和PSNR上分别取得63.7%和83.8%的BD-rate降低，视觉质量也更优。该框架说明残差引导可兼顾高保真与生成式压缩效率。
papers.abstract_en: Generative video compression (GVC) methods usually employ decoder-side diffusion models to denoise reconstructed signals based on generative priors. Besides, most of these methods perform denoising in latent space rather than directly in pixel domain. In this paper, we propose ResGVC, a residual coding framework for GVC that guides denoising toward original pictures by transmitting residual signals. ResGVC first encodes the original pictures within a learned video codec, and then decomposes the distortion between the codec reconstruction and the original pictures into a sequence of residual segments, where each residual segment is acquired at each denoising step. Residual segments can further be compressed by a novel residual codec with a diffusion transformer as an entropy model. Unlike prior methods, ResGVC introduces explicit source constraints throughout denoising rather than relying on decoder-side generation alone. The diffusion-based entropy model also enables more effective distribution modeling capability based on the powerful generative priors. Moreover, denoising directly in pixel space avoids the irreversible information loss caused by latent representation bottlenecks. Experimental results show that, compared with the previous state-of-the-art method, ResGVC achieves 63.7% and 83.8% BD-rate reductions in terms of LPIPS and PSNR, respectively, while also delivering superior visual quality.

papers.title_en: Scaling Transformer Energy-based Models For High Quality Image Synthesis
papers.authors: Jungsoo Lee, Alexi Gladstone, Yilun Du
papers.evidence: 用于图像合成的可扩展Transformer能量生成模型
papers.tldr: 能量模型长期受高维采样与深层训练不稳定困扰，难以扩展到高分辨率图像。本文提出潜空间中的Transformer能量模型TEM，聚合多层能量并引入正表示对齐与改进采样策略。在ImageNet 256×256上无分类器引导取得FID-50K 3.82，512×512达8.24。该工作证明对比式EBM可高质量生成，并保留组合生成、零样本修复与OOD检测能力。
papers.abstract_en: Energy-Based Models (EBMs) are a flexible class of generative models that decouple probabilistic modeling from the generation process. This decoupling directly enables compositional generation and inference-time scaling, where sample quality can be refined simply by increasing sampling steps. However, severe challenges in high-dimensional sampling and training instabilities with deep architectures have restricted EBMs to low-dimensional regimes. To resolve these bottlenecks, we introduce the Transformer Energy-Based Model (TEM), a scalable transformer energy function operating entirely within a latent space. On top of this backbone, we extract energies at multiple layers and sum them, composing complementary constraints from local texture to global semantics. Furthermore, two components make this high-quality at scale: Positive Representation Alignment (PRA), which supervises TEM's intermediate representations with a vision foundation model, and advanced sampling strategies that improve sample quality at inference. TEM-XL achieves an FID-50K of 3.82 on class-conditional ImageNet 256$\times$256 without classifier-free guidance, showing that a contrastive EBM can generate high-fidelity images. On ImageNet 512$\times$512, TEM achieves an FID-50K of 8.24, demonstrating that the approach scales to higher resolution. We further validate the core promises of EBMs: compositional generation, zero-shot inpainting, and out-of-distribution detection.

papers.title_en: MDMR-Bench: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Multi-Reference Image Generation
papers.authors: Bowen Zheng, Jintao Lin, Changheng Yi, Haoran Yang, Binxiao Huang, Chenyang Lei, Rui Liu, Xihui Liu
papers.evidence: 多参考图像生成的多维基准
papers.tldr: 多参考图像生成快速发展，但现有基准评测维度有限，难以覆盖实体融合、属性迁移等多样挑战。本文提出 MDMR-Bench，围绕四类能力构建多子集评测，并设计基于清单的协议，将生成质量拆解为全局与原子级查询进行诊断。对开源与闭源模型的基准测试表明，该基准能提供跨维度的细粒度性能洞察，助力系统分析模型能力与失败模式。
papers.abstract_en: Image generation models have rapidly advanced, with many models now supporting generation conditioned on multiple reference images and textual instructions. Such models enable a wide range of applications, including entity fusion and attribute transfer across images. However, existing benchmarks for multi-reference image generation rely on limited evaluation dimensions and fail to capture the diverse challenges of the task. To address this limitation, we propose MDMR-Bench, a Multi-Dimensional benchmark for Multi-Reference image generation. MDMR-Bench is organized around representative capability settings and consists of multiple evaluation subsets spanning diverse dimensions of multi-reference image generation, including (1) common entity fusion and attribute transfer, (2) multi-element extraction from a single image, (3) infographic manipulation, and (4) visual reasoning-intensive generation. This design enables systematic analysis of model capabilities and failure modes across different challenge dimensions. Furthermore, to achieve more reliable and interpretable evaluation, we introduce a checklist-based evaluation protocol that decomposes generation quality into fine-grained evaluation aspects. Instead of relying solely on holistic scoring, our framework uses structured checklists composed of both global-level and atomic-level queries, enabling more diagnostic assessment of model performance. By benchmarking both open-source and proprietary models, we demonstrate that MDMR-Bench provides fine-grained insights into model performance across different dimensions. The dataset and code are publicly available.
